items: Phone: .sdt / .sdp / .sdv / .sdz and Aseprite files can be picked for import again
Files without a proper name are recognised by what is inside
“Open with Starman Does Animations”: double-click .sdt / .sdp / .sdv / .sdz files in Explorer, and open .aseprite files with it (the Android app too)
Computer updates now also update the program part, not only the page
Cloud sync: the same animations on your computer and phone (Start → Cloud sync). Files are kept in your own private GitHub storage
Syncs by itself after saving, every few minutes and when the app opens; the ☁ button on the taskbar shows the state
If one file was changed on two devices, both versions are kept
Phone and tablet layout: full-screen canvas, tools at the bottom, palette, settings and timeline slide up
Touch: two fingers zoom and move the canvas, two-finger tap = undo, three-finger tap = redo
Install on Android as an app (from the web page, or the APK)
This “What’s new” window, and “Check for updates” in the Start menu
Big animations no longer hit the 5 MB browser limit (files are kept in IndexedDB)
Sprite layers: animated clips with their own tab, ◆ keys choose idle / run / jump…
Hide a sprite on some frames, remove keys on selected frames
◆ motion keys for any layer with the Move tool (“Whole layer”)
Hue / Saturation window (Ctrl+U) like Aseprite
More export formats: Animated PNG, MP4, sheet + JSON, WebP / JPEG
.sdz packages to move animations to another computer
Free transform: scale, turn, slant (Ctrl), one corner (Alt)
Templates gallery with tags and layer colors
Camera zoom and turn while playing
